basics.name: Guido Luz Percú
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 13 years of experience building backend systems and cloud infrastructure with Python and AWS. I've led engineering teams and owned architecture end to end, designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms, serverless architectures, payment flows, and privacy and compliance systems (GDPR/LGPD). I'm currently leading the migration of a core guest-facing product used by more than 10,000 hotels to a modular architecture across the US, EU, and APAC regions. Recent work includes LLM-powered features on AWS Bedrock and AI-assisted developer tooling.

work.name: BidHound
highlights: Architected a multi-tenant SaaS auction platform with PostgreSQL schema-per-tenant isolation and automated tenant provisioning via AWS Lambda, enabling independent auction houses to onboard with zero manual infrastructure setup.

Built an event-driven data ingestion pipeline (S3 → Lambda → Aurora) handling auction imports, photo mapping, invoice reconciliation, and buyer-identity resolution across six external auction marketplaces, backed by a reconciliation ledger that keeps merged multi-day auctions consistent.

Shipped an AI item-categorization and attribute-extraction pipeline on AWS Bedrock (Claude Haiku / Amazon Nova Lite), fanned out through SQS at controlled concurrency, with per-catalog cost benchmarking to keep inference spend predictable.

Built a comparable-sales search engine over historical auction data using PostgreSQL full-text search with a trigram fuzzy fallback, pgvector semantic embeddings (Bedrock Titan V2), and an LLM query-rewrite fallback for thin result sets — with search-quality telemetry that cut the zero-result rate to 2.7%.
Developed a computer-vision auto-crop service for lot photography (subject detection, rotation and scale-sweep correction), the product's most-used daily feature.

Designed and deployed full AWS infrastructure using CDK (TypeScript) across 8 stacks — VPC, Aurora Serverless v2 (auto-scaling), ECS Fargate with Spot instances (~70% cost reduction), Cognito, and CloudWatch monitoring — split into an auto-deployed staging environment and a tag-gated production environment.
Implemented a role-based audit logging system using custom Python decorators capturing before/after snapshots of all entity changes, providing a full compliance trail across all tenant operations.

Ran a privacy engineering audit spanning infrastructure, database schema, application logs, and API payloads — delivering a 5-tier data classification map with legal basis and retention periods, a Records of Processing Activity for GDPR/LGPD, a DPIA gap assessment that flagged stored signature images as biometric data, and a right-to-erasure workflow design that anonymizes PII while preserving legally-required financial records.
